items.source: Entity callback method invoked before a domain object is saved. Can return either the same or a modified instance of the domain object. This method is called before converting the entity to a Map, so the outcome of this callback is used to create the record for the domain object.
items.translation: 在保存域对象之前调用的实体回调方法。可以返回相同的域对象实例或修改后的实例。此方法在将 `entity` 转换为 Map 之前被调用，因此该回调的结果将用于创建域对象的记录。

items.source: Entity callback triggered before an Entity is bound to a record (represented by a java.util.Map<String, Object>).
items.translation: 在将实体绑定到记录（由 java.util.Map<String, Object> 表示）之前触发的实体回调。

items.source: Entity callback method invoked before a domain object is saved.
items.translation: 在保存领域对象之前调用的实体回调方法。

items.source: T - the type of the entity
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: the domain object to be persisted.
